video.title: The FIRST Fantasy Basketball Mock Draft Of The Year - Jokic Or Wemby At 1?

summary: Josh Lloyd does the first 9-category head-to-head mock draft of the season: 12 teams, 14 roster spots, third round reversal. He picks second. Jokic goes first and he takes Wembanyama. His team ends up as Wembanyama, Anthony Davis, Jaylen Brown, Dejounte Murray, Matas Buzelis, Pascal Siakam, Coby White, Immanuel Quickley, Jusuf Nurkic, Shaedon Sharpe, CJ McCollum, Paul Reed, Jeremiah Fears and Jimmy Butler. He comments on value as the picks come in. He thinks Cooper Flagg, Clingan, Derrick White, Dylan Harper and Pritchard went too early. He sees Giannis at 8, Trey Murphy and Trae Young as good value. He is low on Jalen Johnson, Haliburton, Fox and Brunson. His strategy points: draft for value instead of locking into a punt early, take upside flyers from round 10 on, and treat injury-risk veterans differently in head-to-head than in roto. He says picking Quickley over Kevin Porter Jr. was a mistake.
